newsitem.title: BELGIUM: GLAVERBEL HOLDS 10% OF OWN STOCK POST SWAP.
newsitem.headline: GLAVERBEL HOLDS 10% OF OWN STOCK POST SWAP.

text.p: Belgian glass producer Glaverbel said in a statement on Wednesday that it holds 678,088 of its own shares, equivalent to 10 percent of issued capital, following the sale of its AFG Industries unit to its majority shareholder Asahi Glass Co Ltd .
The own shares are held at a price of 3,095 francs, Glaverbel said, equivalent to 2.10 billion Belgian francs.
Glaverbel said that the liquidation of its entire stake in AFG Industries, announced in June, was realised on August 14.

It said the operation had swelled its treasury by 7.2 billion francs, mainly through the sale for around 2.9 billion francs of an interest bearing receivable from Asahi in part payment for the shares.

Glaverbel said the impact from the transactions will appear in the accounts for the second half of the year. They will generate a net capital gain of the order of 1.1 billion francs and help the group cut its debt, it said.
